§6Book of Boxcars§f

§aThe black book that unlocks electronium and the rod of discord.§f

The Book of Boxcars is a rare item found in meteor dungeon safes or the red room. It can also be crafted from 8 black book pages (stamped with Part 1-8 printing press stamps at a burner or electric press) plus a balefire egg. The stamps themselves spawn in meteor dungeon safes that don't contain the book.

§6Uses§f:
§b• Electronium§f: 2 ionized particles + 2 dineutronium powder in the book's 2x2 grid
§b• Rod of Discord§f: ender pearl + blaze rod + euphemium nugget
§b• Other recipes§f: Metastable U238 ingot, Balefire and Steel, Brittle Spade, Diamond/Mese Gavel

The book has a built-in 2x2 crafting grid. A valid recipe makes the GUI glow red.

§ePS:§f Electronium is the critical recipe. It feeds into the FEnSU, your infinite energy storage. Keep the book in your base, not in your inventory, since it's irreplaceable.
